label: human
description: any single member of Homo sapiens, unique extant species of the genus Homo

label: organization
description: social entity established to meet needs or pursue goals

label: musical group
description: musical ensemble which performs music

label: business
description: organization undertaking commercial, industrial, or professional activity

label: nonprofit organization
description: organization operated for a collective benefit

label: company
description: legal entity representing an association of people, whether natural, legal or a mixture of both, with a specific objective

label: work
description: intellectual or artistic creation

label: literary work
description: written work read for enjoyment or edification

label: written work
description: any work expressed in writing, such as inscriptions, manuscripts, documents or maps

label: creative work
description: artistic creation

label: book
description: medium for recording information (words or images) typically on bound pages or more abstractly in electronic or audio form

label: film
description: visual art work that simulates experiences and communicates ideas, stories, or emotions through moving images, generally synchronized with sound since the 1930s

label: animated film
description: film for the cinema, television or computer screen that is made by using drawings, stop motion or computer animation

label: television film
description: film format that is broadcast and distributed specifically for television networks.

label: painting
description: visual artwork, surface artistically covered with paint

label: album
description: grouping of album releases by an artist usually released at the same time with the same title and tracks but in different formats for consumption (digital, CD, LP)

label: television series
description: connected set of television program episodes under the same title

label: video game
description: electronic game with user interface and visual feedback

label: software
description: non-tangible executable component of a computer

label: physical location
description: position of something in space

label: geographic location
description: point, line or area on or near Earth

label: city
description: large human settlement

label: metropolis
description: large and significant city or urban area usually with millions of inhabitants

label: human settlement
description: place of any size, in which people permanently live

label: administrative territorial entity
description: territorial entity for administration purposes, with or without its own local government

label: river
description: larger natural watercourse

label: mountain
description: large natural elevation of the Earth's surface

label: country
description: distinct territorial body or political entity

label: lake
description: body of relatively still water, localized in a basin

label: inner planet of the Solar System
description: Mercury, Venus, Earth, and Mars

label: taxon
description: group of one or more organism(s), which a taxonomist adjudges to be a unit

label: chicken breed
description: breed of domestic chickens

label: organisms known by a particular common name
description: organisms which have been assigned common names in addition to their taxon name

label: type of chemical entity
description: Wikidata metaclass that covers physical entities of interest in chemistry including molecular entities and pure chemical substances

label: chemical compound
description: pure chemical substance consisting of two or more different chemical elements

label: chemical substance
description: matter of constant composition best characterized by the entities (molecules, formula units, atoms) it is composed of and characterized by physical properties like density

label: natural language
description: language naturally spoken or signed by humans, as opposed to "constructed" and "formal" languages

label: programming language
description: language for communicating instructions to a machine

label: advanced emotion
description: according to the theory of emotion

label: theme
description: central topic, subject, or message within a narrative

label: human spaceflight
description: space travel with humans aboard spacecraft

label: earthquake
description: result of a sudden release of energy in the Earth's crust that creates seismic waves

label: character
description: fictional human or non-human character in a narrative work of art

label: deity
description: natural or supernatural god or goddess, divine being

label: thunder deity
description: type of god

label: Greek deity
description: type or kind of deity belonging to the Greek mythological universe

label: Wikimedia disambiguation page
description: type of wiki page usually in main namespace (article namespace, ns=0) containing links to articles with similar names, and very little details only, use with P31 "instance of"

label: Wikimedia list article
description: page of a Wikimedia project with a list of something

label: Wikimedia set index article
description: list article about a set of items of a specific type that share the same (or similar) name

label: Wikimedia category
description: use with 'instance of' (P31) for Wikimedia category
